signatures (the seams in docs/extending/README.md and the types they are made of)
  AgentRunner (packages/core/src/lib/seams.ts)
    export interface AgentRunner {
        id: string;
        capabilities: {
            streaming: boolean;
            skills: boolean;
        };
        run(prompt: string, opts: {
            cwd: string;
            timeoutMs?: number;
        }): Promise<string>;
        runStreaming?(prompt: string, opts: {
            cwd: string;
            onEvent: (e: {
                kind: "tool" | "text";
                label: string;
            }) => void;
        }): Promise<string>;
    }
  CompletionProvider (packages/core/src/lib/seams.ts)
    export interface CompletionProvider {
        id: string;
        capabilities: {
            vision: boolean;
        };
        complete(req: {
            system?: string;
            prompt: string;
            parts?: ContentPart[];
            maxTokens?: number;
        }): Promise<string>;
    }
  ContentPart (packages/core/src/lib/seams.ts)
    export type ContentPart = {
        kind: "text";
        text: string;
    } | {
        kind: "image";
        data: Uint8Array;
        mimeType: string;
    } | {
        kind: "pdf";
        data: Uint8Array;
    };
  EmbeddingProvider (packages/core/src/lib/seams.ts)
    export interface EmbeddingProvider {
        id: string;
        dimensions: number;
        embed(texts: string[]): Promise<Float32Array[]>;
        embedQuery(text: string, opts?: {
            signal?: AbortSignal;
        }): Promise<Float32Array>;
        embedImage?(buffer: Uint8Array, mimeType: string, description: string): Promise<Float32Array>;
        embedPdf?(buffer: Uint8Array, description: string): Promise<Float32Array>;
    }
  SkillEmitter (packages/core/src/lib/seams.ts)
    export interface SkillEmitter {
        agent: string;
        emit(skills: SkillManifest[], repoRoot: string): {
            written: string[];
            removed: string[];
            warnings?: string[];
        };
    }
  SkillManifest (packages/core/src/lib/seams.ts)
    export interface SkillManifest {
        name: string;
        description: string;
        dir: string;
        source: "core" | "module" | "local";
        frontmatter: Record<string, unknown>;
    }
